frozen_target.reference_formula: Write d=g alpha and d'=g beta. Under (m,beta)=(alpha,m')=(m,m')=1 test tau_0(g alpha,m,g beta,m')=(g m,alpha,g beta,m') and tau_1(g alpha,m,g beta,m')=(g alpha,m,g m',beta). On chi_4(alpha m)=chi_4(beta m')=-1 the formal orbit sum is F(g alpha,g beta)-F(g m,g beta)-F(g alpha,g m')+F(g m,g m'), equal to [lambda_1(g beta)-lambda_1(g m')] conjugate([lambda_0(g alpha)-lambda_0(g m)]). The candidate power is (D_L/L)(D_L L^2)=D_L^2 L<=L^2.
quantities: Use the complete physical source N=dm, N+r=d'm', d,d' odd, 0<r<R_0 and r even, with literal endpoint coefficients, character product, Fejer factor, radical phase and zero extensions.
Impose P2=1_(|d-gm|<=D_L)1_(|d'-gm'|>D_L) before spectral operations; retain the exact Round-195 open packet complement.
Use an independent swap only where every recomputed gcd equals g and price every missing corner or literal predicate exit.
The rectangular sign sector has chi_4(alpha m)=chi_4(beta m')=-1 and hence r divisible by four; it is distinct from the Round-193 r=2 mod 4 simultaneous reversal.

Only the actual endpoint mixed difference may provide D_L/L. Normalized BV, selectors, floors, stars, profile branches, masks, cones, source orientation, cells, crossings, births, deaths and zero extensions remain explicit.
